{{Quote|There were no barricades for five years. Daans and Melidas mixed in both sectors. In some neighborhoods they even lived side by side. Then the Twenty-Fifth Battle of Zehava began.|[[Cerasi]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>}}
The '''Twenty-Fifth Battle of Zehava''' was a battle of the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] that occurred circa [[86 BBY/Legends|86 BBY]]. Before that battle there was a period of relative peace on Melida/Daan that lasted for five years.
